title: Technology Sector Update for 01/14/2019: CAMT,MAXR,WDC
text:

Technology stocks were falling during Monday trade, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing over 0.7% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was posting a more than 0.9% decline.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Camtek ( CAMT ) climbed as much as 6% on Monday after the semiconductor inspections company reaffirmed its Q4 outlook expecting between $32.5 million to $33.5 million in revenue, straddling the two-analyst estimate expecting $33 million for the three months ended Dec. 31.
In other sector news:
(+) Maxar Technologies ( MAXR ) was 3.8% higher in recent trading after the networking equipment company named Daniel Jablonsky as its new CEO and president, succeeding Howard Lance who also stepped down as a board member in addition to resigning those positions.
(-) Western Digital ( WDC ) slumped Monday, falling almost 10% at one point, after Evercore ISI lowered its investment rating on the data-storage company's shares to underperform from in line.
